title: Unlocking European Market Potential with GoAustria
excerpt: We are excited to share our partici…
html:
We are excited to share our participation in the GoAustria Info Session: Unlock European Market Potential, organized by ADVANTAGE AUSTRIA Hong Kong, the Global Incubator Network (GIN), and Hong Kong Science and Technology Park.

The event provided a fantastic opportunity to learn about Austria’s innovation ecosystem and its role as a gateway to the European market. As part of the session, we had the honor of meeting and engaging with Ms. Jennifer Veigel, the Austrian Trade Commissioner for Hong Kong & Macau. Her insights and expertise were truly inspiring, and we are grateful for the opportunity to discuss the potential of AI-driven health solutions in Europe.

The highlight of the event was capturing this special moment in a photo with Ms. Jennifer Veigel. Moments like these encourage us to push forward in our mission to deliver innovative health solutions globally.

A heartfelt thanks to the organizers for creating this valuable platform for startups like ours to connect, learn, and grow!
